text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Looks like no one else's clothes got mixed in.
Alright. Once I fold this—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Ah... the trash can is full.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Let's toss this out while we're at it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Messiah, huh.
Wasn't Beautification Committee day yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-senpai.
It's time to replace the flowers in the dorm vases, so I was thinking of choosing some.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, the one down the hall? Good catch.
Here, let me lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho... That's all the water bottles.
Now, to restock the paper cups.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hey, Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing?
Were you on exchange duty today?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No.
It just looked like it was about to run out.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I thought I'd get it done while rehydrating.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see... You changed the flowers in the vase too, didn't you?
Your thoughtfulness is always such a huge help.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta give something in return.
What would be good?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's gather everyone who owes this guy a favor
and throw a massive bash! Go all out!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I bet they'll be happy too. They're always saying how much they owe you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sounds great.
It looks like it's going to be a huge crowd.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Um... thank you very much, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: However, there is no need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
What do you mean? It's right there!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "If you're just holding back to be polite, you really don't need to worry about it, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: No, it's not like that...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I am merely abiding by the dorm rule
to 'live with consideration for others.'"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: It is not something I deserve thanks for.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —Ah, jeez! You really are something else!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Squish!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ph-Phould phou phelp phe?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're saying we wanna do it,
your only choices are 'Yes' or 'Yes'!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: F-Fahh...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That's true.
I think it's wonderful that you feel like
you 'only did what was natural,' but...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: “Still, that's completely separate from our desire to look after you. ...We just want to show our gratitude for how hard you work!”

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
So just follow me quietly, okay?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...In that case, I will gladly take you up on that.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...And that is what happened.
I was deeply impressed to learn
such a perspective even existed."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: So, about that... Trainer, is there anything you would like right now?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I am helped daily by all the work you do,
so I would like to show you some care and appreciation as well.
choice_data_list: Hmm, it's not like I'm particularly tired, either...
Then can I count on you for the heavy lifting?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Most of what I do is just work, not something I need to be thanked for. When I told her that—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No.
That's separate from my own desire to look after you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If you refuse to nod, I will subject you to
'Cheek Squishing Punishment,' taught to me directly by Pokke-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Your only acceptable answers are "Yes" or "Yes, ma'am,"
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry to dump odd jobs on you, but..."
I said, pointing to the cardboard boxes in the corner of the room.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Of course. Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, this alone won't be enough.
...Is there anything else? Trainer-san.
